newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai panel approves 1997 foreign borrowing plan.
newsitem.headline: Thai panel approves 1997 foreign borrowing plan.

text.p: A Thai cabinet panel on Monday approved a Finance Ministry proposal to borrow $4.1 billion abroad in fiscal 1997 to finance major infrastructure and expansion projects, a government spokesman said.
The Thai fiscal year begins on October 1.
The ministry had announced that it would borrow the money on October 18. The cabinet panel will submit the borrowing plan to the cabinet on Tuesday for final approval.

Major projects to be financed include the construction of a second international airport in Bangkok, an underground mass transit system and the purchase of new aircraft by Thai Airways International Plc, the spokesman said.
In fiscal 1996, ending September 30, the Thai government borrowed a total of $3.7 billion abroad.
